close_reason: Added maintainer notes on TransportConfig and AuthProvider trait definitions explicitly calling out the manual blanket impls that need mirroring when methods are added. Lowest-cost of the three options the bead suggested. No code change.
description: src/auth.rs:256-289 — three nearly-identical blanket impls for Box<dyn TransportConfig>, Arc<dyn AuthProvider>, Box<dyn AuthProvider>, each forwarding the single trait method. The comments correctly note 'every method added to TransportConfig must be mirrored here' — that maintenance burden is real and silently breaks future minor-version expansions. Idiomatic alternatives: (a) automate via a macro (delegate-attr or duplicate crate, but that adds a dep), (b) keep the trait small (currently one method each, so cost is bounded), (c) document the invariant on the trait definition with a doc-comment so future maintainers see it before adding a method. Current state is fine for one method but will rot if the traits grow. Note: locked crate.
title: Box<dyn AuthProvider>, Arc<dyn AuthProvider>, Box<dyn TransportConfig> have manual blanket impls
